Name: Michal, Daughter of Saul
Summary: Daughter of Saul who saw David dancing before the ark and despised him in her heart.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:29: Daughter of Saul who saw David dancing before the ark and despised him in her heart.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Michal stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
